clips.title: The story
paras: Searing Gorge is a scorched, desolate canyon in southern Khaz Modan, bordering Blackrock Mountain to the south. Once a verdant expanse of the Redridge Mountains, it was devastated over two centuries ago by the apocalyptic summoning of Ragnaros the Firelord. Today, the gorge is heavily worked by the Dark Iron clan, whose extensive slave mines in the Cauldron are closely monitored by the breakaway Thorium Brotherhood.

Before the War of the Three Hammers, the territory that is now Searing Gorge was a green, rolling mountain region connected to the Redridge chain. That lush landscape ceased to exist over two hundred and thirty years ago when Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan, desperate to turn the tide of defeat, summoned Ragnaros from the depths beneath the world. The cataclysmic emergence of the Firelord tore the earth asunder, raised Blackrock Mountain, reduced the grand Dark Iron city of Thaurissan to smoking ruins, and burned the northern valley into a cracked expanse of ash, sulfur, and volcanic glass.

Seeking raw materials to supply their war machine after the loss of their old capital, the Dark Iron dwarves seized the desolate gorge. In the center of the valley lies the Cauldron, a colossal open-pit excavation plunging deep into the stone. Within its lower recesses sits the Slag Pit, a brutal subterranean mining complex. Here, Dark Iron overseers and lumbering war golems drive captured enemies into grueling slave labor, pulling iron, mithril, and rare deposits of Dark Iron ore out of the burning rock under the constant threat of lava surges and roaming beasts.

Perched on the northern crags overlooking the excavation sits Thorium Point, the fortified outpost of the Thorium Brotherhood. Having split from their kin in Blackrock Mountain, these master craftsmen offer neutral shelter to travelers willing to undermine the Dark Iron operations or supply them with rare smelting components. Access to the gorge itself is tightly restricted: the Alliance keeps the Stonewrought Pass locked down behind heavy iron gates toward Loch Modan, while Horde expeditions from nearby Kargath have cut a narrow trail through the eastern badlands to scout the region.
